hypothesis: Actual accepted histories show substantial physical identity contamination; refuse ambiguous existing-track identity writes after geometry updates, independently of predictive scoring.
threshold_basis: Confidence matches original native newborn threshold0.68; one predeclared conservative0.02 row/column cost margin. No dev threshold sweep/calibration or guaranteed precision claim.
margin_definition: Native assignment cost for the accepted current proposal versus minimum of every other row/column candidate and native stage NULL threshold0.97 or0.7. Non-best Hungarian assignments can have negative margin and are refused.
low_stage: Original low-score IoU geometry association/update continues unchanged; identity write refused without current scored high/unconfirmed evidence.
newborn: Native confident birth/lifecycle unchanged; allow first available identity initialization, then apply policy to every existing-track write.
rejected: Set pending=false, preserve past identity history/prototype/timestamps; current matched detection may update geometry. No delayed future-frame rewriting or GT recovery.
budget: Independent on/off comparison at identical fixed model weights and weight0.3; no new appearance setting search.
scope: Same fixed write thresholds with anchor GRU weights; independent joint/PLIM on/off diagnosis, not new threshold search.
